entries.name: MTHFR C677T
entries.summary: TT (here AA on forward strand) reduces enzyme activity ~70%, raises homocysteine when folate is low. Clinical impact is small with adequate folate; not a reason for high-dose supplements.

entries.name: HFE C282Y
entries.summary: Main hereditary haemochromatosis variant. AA (C282Y homozygous) = high iron-overload risk; check ferritin/transferrin saturation. Carriers are usually unaffected.

entries.name: HFE H63D
entries.summary: Milder haemochromatosis variant; matters mainly as compound heterozygote with C282Y.

GG.label: H63D homozygous: mild iron loading possible

entries.name: ADH1B*2 (Arg48His)
entries.summary: T allele = fast alcohol-to-acetaldehyde conversion, flushing, strong protection against alcohol dependence.

CT.label: fast ADH1B, flushing likely, lower dependence risk

entries.name: ALDH2*2
entries.summary: A allele inactivates ALDH2: alcohol flush, higher oesophageal cancer risk with drinking. Rare outside East Asia.

entries.name: COMT Val158Met
entries.summary: Met (A) allele = slower dopamine clearance in prefrontal cortex ('worrier': better memory, more stress sensitivity); Val (G) = 'warrior'. Effects are small and context dependent.

entries.name: FOXE1 rs965513
entries.summary: A allele raises thyroid cancer risk (~1.7x per allele) and is linked to hypothyroidism/TSH levels.

entries.name: MSMB rs10993994
entries.summary: T allele raises prostate cancer risk ~1.25x per allele and lowers PSA-independent MSMB expression.

entries.name: CFH Y402H
entries.summary: C allele is the main common risk factor for age-related macular degeneration (~2.5x heterozygous, ~6x homozygous). Smoking multiplies the risk.

entries.name: HLA-DQ2.5 tag
entries.summary: Tags HLA-DQ2.5, present in ~90% of coeliac disease patients. Absence nearly rules coeliac disease out; presence alone is common (~25% of Europeans).

TT.label: two DQ2.5 haplotypes: higher coeliac risk

entries.name: Lactase persistence -13910C>T
entries.summary: A allele (T on the minus strand) keeps lactase active in adults. GG on forward strand = lactase non-persistence, lactose intolerance likely in adulthood.

entries.name: MC1R R151C
entries.summary: Red-hair/fair-skin allele; raises melanoma risk ~2x per allele independent of pigmentation.

TT.label: homozygous: red hair likely, ~4x melanoma risk
